title: Add a currency field to Price
prompt: In money.py, add a `currency` field to the Price dataclass, defaulting to "USD", and include it in the to_dict() output. Price(amount=1.0, currency="EUR").to_dict() must report the given currency.
optimal_steps_note: Minimum tool calls with run_verify available: one write per allowed file, one verify, one finish. Files are seeded into the prompt, so reads are not required. The verify-off arm has a floor one lower.
